Quiz cards · answer key

How a Zipper Holds Shut and Comes Apart

Q1 · A. Bumps tuck into hollows
Each tooth has a bump and a hollow, and the slider squeezes each bump into the next hollow.
Q2 · B. A tiny lock holds it
With the pull-tab flat, a tiny piece under the slider slips between two teeth and holds it still.
Q3 · C. So both rows line up
With the pin fully in the box, both rows start lined up and the first teeth can mesh.
Q4 · A. Keeps the slider on
Stops at each end keep the slider on the teeth.
C1 · Say it your way
elements: another name for a zipper's teeth.
C2 · Draw it
Look for two offset rows, with each tooth fitting between two teeth on the other side.

The cards name a key marker such as KEY Q2. Answer positions are shuffled for this sheet, so use the letters on this page, not the order in the web quiz. Print the cards and this key separately.
